evals.prompt: /update. I downloaded this Studio as a ZIP and have no Git checkout. I already downloaded a newer ZIP from the confirmed repository at revision test-v2. Preview it only. I customized AGENTS.md and have saved preferences and production assets; there is no recorded installed baseline.
evals.expected_output: Use an external staged local-archive preview. Treat differing existing source files as conflicts without a baseline and protect preferences/production assets. Do not install Git, execute received code or apply changes.
assertions: The preview identifies changed existing AGENTS.md as a conflict, not an upstream-only update.
Preferences and production assets are protected and the original workspace remains unchanged.
No Git initialization, installation, received-code execution or applying changes occurs without approval.

evals.prompt: /update. I use Windows without compatible Python or Git. I have an official ZIP, but do not download, install or replace anything yet. Explain the safe update route that preserves my current workspace.
evals.expected_output: Disclose the automated helper's POSIX requirement and propose a reviewed manual side-by-side staging workflow. Preserve the entire old workspace, transfer local preferences/assets only with approval, and report alias/provenance limitations.
assertions: The response identifies that automatic POSIX apply is unsupported rather than claiming Windows support.
The fallback keeps the original workspace intact and uses a separate staged/new workspace.
Downloads, installation, transfers and executing received code require separate explicit scope.
